User Request: Show total revenue by product category, from highest to lowest.

Dashboard Components:
Title: Total Revenue by Product Category
Type: chart
Description: Total revenue aggregated by product category, displayed from highest to lowest.

sql_queries.title: Total Revenue by Product Category
sql_queries.description: Total revenue aggregated by product category, displayed from highest to lowest.
sql_queries.sql: SELECT c.CategoryName, SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) AS TotalRevenue FROM 'Order Details' od JOIN Products p ON od.ProductID = p.ProductID JOIN Categories c ON p.CategoryID = c.CategoryID GROUP BY c.CategoryName ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC
